question: Should generic tool-progress intent become a permanent public reply-payload Plugin SDK contract for cross-plugin delivery behavior?
rationale: The bug fix needs a generic Codex-to-Slack seam, but exporting the field, constant, and predicate creates third-party compatibility obligations that cannot be inferred from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Keep Public Contract
options.body: Retain the generic reply-payload metadata, document its semantics, and add focused compatibility coverage after fixing the structured-block path.

options.title: Use Bundled Internal Seam
options.body: Move the progress marker to a bundled-only internal runtime contract and avoid expanding the third-party Plugin SDK surface.

recommendation.title: Keep Public Contract
recommendation.body: Retain the generic reply-payload metadata, document its semantics, and add focused compatibility coverage after fixing the structured-block path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest overlap across Slack native-block delivery and the public reply-payload SDK surface.
